main.description: Every feature flag's public gates, and whether the caller is targeted by account or group. Inter-service auth is optional: without it, nothing is targeted. A flag is on for a caller when it's on for everyone, when it targets them, or when their DID falls inside the percentage. Group names and member lists aren't exposed.

errors.name: AuthenticationRequired
errors.description: A token was sent and isn't valid.

targeted.description: The caller is one of the flag's accounts or in one of its groups.
